whatItIs: qupy is an open-source project in the general-purpose sdks category. It is maintained by ken-nakanishi and primarily looks like a Python codebase. QuPy is a quantum circuit simulator for both CPU and GPU.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches general-purpose sdks workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: QuPy is a quantum circuit simulator for both CPU and GPU. The features of QuPy are as follows. **fast**: You can experiment with your idea quickly! **simple**: You can experiment with your idea easily!
